predictions.articleTitle: Wanderers vs Juventud Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Relegation Urgency Crack Juventud's Block?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Juventud's Clausura defensive edge supports Draw / Away Win alongside Under 2.5 goals in a tight penultimate-round fixture.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win double chance balances Juventud's 41.9% Poisson win share against a 29.4% draw probability (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 goals backed by a 2.12 combined lambda and 64.4% Poisson density under three goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Late second-half scoring surge if Wanderers' survival urgency opens transition space after 65 minutes (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Wanderers' survival urgency meets Juventud's stingy 0.77 goals-conceded defense.

spf.comment: Juventud's 0.77 goals-conceded rate backs a 0:1 away win, while their 50.0% big-chance waste and six Clausura draws make a 1:1 stalemate too likely to leave uncovered with a single call.

over_under.comment: Combined goal expectancy of 2.12 and a 64.4% Poisson Under 2.5 probability align with both sides averaging roughly one goal per Clausura match.

score.comment: Top Poisson scorelines reflect either Juventud grinding out a single transition strike or Wanderers' 16-day rest earning a level share.

goals.comment: Two-goal (27.0%) and one-goal (25.4%) outcomes capture over half of the Poisson total-goals distribution.

bqc.comment: Cautious opening tactics favor a level first half before Juventud either capitalize on late home risk or settle for a draw.
